preregistered: 2026-11-07 ~19:00 CT, committed before any HE-17 result was computed

evaluations.A: fit expert prior + stacker on TRAIN, predict VALIDATION, official slot_forecasting.rounds.score_round (development-exposed: params and SIZE_REGIMES were chosen on these targets)
evaluations.B: fit on VALIDATION, predict TRAIN queries, five-class observed-outcome Brier, condition-averaged (independent of validation target vectors except SIZE_REGIMES)

uncertainty: paired bootstrap over episodes within condition, 4000 resamples, seed 0
decision_rule: A difference counts as supported only if its 95% interval excludes 0 in A AND B points the same way (B interval need not exclude 0). No variant is promoted by this study; promotion needs lane A approval.
known_prior_results: HE-03 (#3) already measured nostack, nosig and causal on A and B; they are re-run here in the same harness for a single table.

variants.name: nostack
variants.hypothesis: Gradient-boosting stacker is the largest single component.

variants.name: nosig
variants.hypothesis: Query-time signal in the stacker adds little outside the selection split.

variants.name: no_size_experts
variants.hypothesis: Context-specific size experts beat the machine-level size regime posterior.

variants.name: no_peer_evidence
variants.hypothesis: Sibling expert log-likelihood helps pick lag experts, especially under shared_change.

variants.name: no_expert_prior
variants.hypothesis: Train-learned prior over expert types helps short histories.

variants.name: single_lag_only
variants.hypothesis: Win probability depends on lag PAIRS; removing pair experts hurts a lot.

variants.name: binary_categories_only
variants.hypothesis: 3-way 0/1/2+ contexts add little over win/loss contexts.

variants.name: slower_forgetting
variants.hypothesis: Faster forgetting (lam 0.95) tracks drift; slower forgetting hurts drift.

variants.name: faster_forgetting
variants.hypothesis: Forgetting faster than 0.95 loses too much evidence.

variants.name: train_size_regimes
variants.hypothesis: Exposure-free size regimes (train-only EM, 32-tick windows, from HE-03) cost points vs validation-derived constants.

variants.name: control_shuffled_stack_labels
variants.hypothesis: NEGATIVE CONTROL: stacker trained on permuted labels must be much worse than champion and than nostack.
